title: Did Isaac Del Toro Work For Brandon McNulty? Losing Rivals Call out UAE Team ‘Alliances’ at Road Worlds
content:
Team vs. country debate ignites after Montréal worlds as riders and pundits call out Mexico's Del Toro for 'helping' trade teammate McNulty.

Read the full article at Did Isaac Del Toro Work For Brandon McNulty? Losing Rivals Call out UAE Team ‘Alliances’ at Road Worlds on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
